recommendation: Provide frontline support for patients with substance use disorders
implementation_steps: Serve as frontline contacts in community pharmacies for patients with substance use disorders
Identify patients at risk through prescription patterns and interactions
Provide nonjudgmental support and reduce stigma during pharmacy interactions
Facilitate communication between patients and pharmacists about medication concerns
Support naloxone access programs through patient identification and education
evidence_summary: Pharmacy technician interventions supporting patients with substance use disorders have been shown to improve medication access, reduce stigma, and enhance communication with healthcare providers in pharmacy settings.
